FN-D7EKTN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 73
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/21/2023
House Bill 73 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of each local board of
education and charter school by requiring the development and adoption of intradistrict and
interdistrict enrollment policies, as well as the public posting of these policies to the board or
school's website.
